grid.title: 1 — Electricity grid
grid.description: Map available grid measurements, or leave empty. Signed grid power keeps its sign; export is shown as a positive magnitude. These readings are not added together. No commands will be sent.

solar.title: 2 — Solar production
solar.description: Choose a total production measurement in W or kW, or leave empty if you have no solar installation.

home.title: 3 — Home consumption
home.description: Choose measured total home consumption in W or kW. This first increment does not calculate a balance or add submeters.

review.title: 4 — Review measurements

confirm.title: Save in observation mode
confirm.description: {summary}\n\nSubmit to save mappings. Unavailable measurements stay unavailable. Settings reload without a full HA restart. Dashboard and storage are not yet part of this wizard. To correct an error, select return to review.

error.select_source: Select at least one sensor before saving.
error.duplicate_source: This sensor is already mapped to another reading.
error.recursive_source: Select an original source, not an eHome EMS sensor.
error.missing_source: This sensor no longer exists. Choose another source.
error.unsupported_unit: The sensor unit must be W or kW.
error.sources_changed: A source is missing, duplicated or has an invalid unit. Return to review to correct the mappings.

abort.already_configured: eHome EMS is already configured. Use Configure to edit its settings.
